_doc: Framing contract for SVG assets served from public/. Every SVG in public/ that declares a viewBox MUST have an entry here, and its declared viewBox/width/height must match this manifest (tolerance: 0.5 user units for viewBox, exact for width/height). scripts/check-hero-assets.mjs enforces this at prebuild; scripts/normalize-hero-assets.mjs (requires playwright, dev-only) measures real bounds and proposes curated values. SVGs without a declared viewBox are outside the contract. Keys are paths relative to public/ using POSIX separators. width/height are null when the SVG does not declare them.

dashboard/cientifico-1.svg.note: Curated: original viewBox 128.6 69.52 762.01 884.97 cut ~70 user units off the top (the head). Content is 673.6 x 1024 anchored at (172.8, 0). Final frame: 917 x 1065 window centered on the content with 21 user units of padding, matching the 440 x 511 canvas shared by cientifica-1 and cientifico-x so all three scientist figures share one aspect ratio. Side padding instead of cropping legs: nothing of the drawing is lost.
